$comment: Audit store (ADR-0007; data-model §3.4, §4.4, §5; TASK-021). Every table is SYSTEM (no RLS, ADR-0005; PR12-SEC-08): access only through packages/audit, whose viewer repository applies the organisation scope. All eight tables and every audit_entries_YYYY_MM partition are owned by platform_audit_owner and created only in the bootstrap lane (prisma/bootstrap/10-audit.sql); Prisma never diffs them (tables.external). Partitions are not listed: C1 skips partitions and C5 requires zero privileges on them. immutable marks the append-only tables carrying the immutability triggers (catalog test C7): audit_entries (also C6, with the per-partition triggers), audit_checkpoint_heads, audit_anchors and audit_pii_vault (whose row trigger is audit_vault_guard, admitting only the M4/M5 erasure DELETE). audit_stream_heads, audit_partitions and audit_chain_verifications are mutable by design; data_subjects is insert-only plus erased_at, enforced by the grants, not a trigger.
